summary.text: Mary Beth Walsh is the incumbent Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 112 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney with a law practice in Ballston Spa, she was first elected to the Assembly in 2016 and serves as Assembly Minority Leader Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: Walsh has been a practicing attorney for over 30 years and has practiced almost exclusively representing children in Family Court for over 15 years.

Before her election to the Assembly, she served two terms as a councilwoman in the Town of Ballston and as a member of the Saratoga County IDA, the Saratoga County Ethics Advisory Council and the Saratoga County Autism Council.
Walsh was first elected to the Assembly on November 8, 2016, and represents the 112th Assembly District, which includes parts of Saratoga, Schenectady and Fulton counties.
She became Assembly Minority Leader Pro Tempore in 2025, having been Assistant Minority Leader Pro Tempore since 2020.
She sits on the Judiciary and Ways and Means committees, the Commission on Administrative Regulations Review and the Legislative Women's Caucus.
Her official biography also lists her as Secretary of the American Irish Legislators Society and a director of the bicameral, bipartisan Legislative Women's Caucus, and says she lives in Burnt Hills.
